Furniture Retail Market Analyzer

National furniture market intelligence: compare market opportunity, identify high-value audiences, drill into counties and ZIPs, and prioritize advertising geography.

Build 1.8.21 · Production
Data & Methodology Status — Build 1.8.21
Integrated: 31,788 ZIP geography records; 2023 ZBP NAICS 442110 (2,822 reported ZIPs; 15,124 establishments); ACS 2024 5-year B25038 recent-mover triggers (32,819 ZCTAs with valid occupied-unit denominators). Candidate model: Trigger 40% + Buying Power 25% + Customer Fit/Homeownership 20% + Household Scale Index 15%, component indexes capped at 50–150. Validation: 422 Metro markets tested; alternative-weight rank correlations 0.990–0.996, but exact positions remain weight-sensitive. Retail Footprint: descriptive only because suppressed/unreported ZBP ZIPs are not treated as zero. Opportunity tiers use fixed score bands: Very High ≥120, High 110–119.9, Moderate 90–109.9, Low 80–89.9, Very Low <80; they are not percentile buckets. Build 1.7.3 adds a non-destructive DMA candidate preview using the same ZIP-derived 40/25/20/15 methodology; the legacy National/DMA ranking remains the default until DMA behavior is validated.

Select a DMA

Click a DMA row to inspect its underlying metrics.
Rank By: Purchasing Potential ranks geographies by the absolute size of the modeled furniture-purchasing opportunity. Furniture Opportunity Index ranks geographies by relative furniture opportunity/propensity rather than sheer market size.
Geographic workflow: U.S. → DMA → Metro → County → ZIP. Each level ranks the next geography using the standardized Furniture Opportunity methodology. Store Trade Area / ZIP Radius is a separate audience-targeting workflow.

Furniture model: Furniture Opportunity Index, Audience Index (U.S.=100), and Audience Potential will be calculated from nationwide public data. Components: Purchase Triggers, Buying Power, Customer Fit, Demand Potential, and Furniture Retail Footprint. Market Outlook is descriptive, not a filter: each selected DMA, Metro, County or ZIP will automatically display Strong, Above Average, Average, Below Average or Limited Furniture Opportunity based on its validated Furniture Opportunity Index.
Purchase Trigger: aggregated from ACS B25038 ZCTA counts using occupied housing units as the denominator. Metro/County values are recomputed from component counts—not averages of ZIP indexes.

Data & Methodology
Furniture Opportunity model: Recent Move Index 40% + Income Index 25% + Homeownership Index 20% + Household Scale Index 15%. Retail Footprint remains descriptive until suppressed ZBP values can be incorporated without treating missing values as zero. The scoring model is applied consistently across DMA, Metro, County, ZIP and Trade Area analysis.
Demographic foundationU.S. Census Bureau ACS 2024 5-year data supplies households, owner occupancy, household income and the B25038 move-in-period measure used for Recent Move Rate.
Retail footprintU.S. Census Bureau ZIP/County Business Patterns, NAICS 442110, supplies furniture-store establishment counts where reported. Suppressed or missing values remain unknown, never zero.
Index benchmarkAn index of 100 represents the national benchmark for the applicable measure. Values above 100 are above that benchmark; values below 100 are below it.
Furniture OpportunityProprietary Adtaxi analytical framework: 40% Recent Move Index + 25% Income Index + 20% Homeownership Index + 15% Household Scale Index. The weighting is our model, not a Census or BEA methodology.
Map geographyMetro, County and ZIP/Radius views use the analyzer’s embedded ZIP centroid geography for map positioning. Radius maps also draw the selected mileage circle. Map position is visualization only and does not alter rankings or calculations.

Current Trade Area ranking: Furniture Opportunity: Recent Move Index 40% + Income Index 25% + Homeownership Index 20% + Household Scale Index 15%. Distance determines inclusion only; it does not alter scoring. Missing/suppressed source values remain unreported, never zero.
Store Trade Area / ZIP Radius methodology
The tool calculates straight-line distance between the center ZIP centroid and other ZIP centroids. Every ZIP centroid within the selected mileage radius is included. Included ZIPs are scored with the same QA Furniture Opportunity Candidate used in Metro/County/ZIP analysis. Furniture Retail Footprint remains descriptive because suppressed/unreported establishment counts are not treated as zero. Missing or suppressed source values remain unknown.
Planned production sources: U.S. Census ACS 2024 5-year demographic and housing data; Census County Business Patterns / ZIP Business Patterns for furniture retail establishments; state-level BEA consumer-spending context. Revised QA DMA rankings are embedded for model review. Small-market volatility is damped. ACS move-trigger and ZBP furniture-retail inputs are integrated; the composite opportunity model remains under QA validation.
